observations: clientCall appends callback to ed.clientCall_list; it does not execute it
battleBaseScene.onUpdate clears queue before engine.update and drains captured queue by shift afterwards
Callbacks appended to the captured queue during draining also execute in the same drain
Replacing ed.clientCall_list while draining does not replace the locally captured drain array
battleBaseScene.snapshot with openDebug compares serialized engine state plus random_seed around each callback and pauses on divergence
Local engine.update executes at most one tick per call, then advances next_tick to a positive value without catchup ticks
Background-scene onUpdate drains existing queue before resetting the queue; it is a distinct execution contract
